notes.title: Save your Work - Bug fixes, new passives, and 50 000 sales

notes.title: Mor(gu)e Content - Bug fixes and balance
notes.notes: [p]Another day, another patch! Once again, thanks for all of the bug reports, it's very helpful. And sorry about the little bug where we disabled sweat collection, it's fixed now.[/p][p][/p][h3]Big things:[/h3][list][*][p]Morgue is now purchasable![/p][/*][*][p]Teleport ability fixes, we're trying to catch them all! [/p][/*][*][p]You can now pay to reroll your opponent in Cage Fight[/p][/*][*][p]Localisation updates[/p][/*][*][p]Some buffs for the Custodian and putting people into bubbles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with collecting souls[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Fire Extinguisher in Cage Fight[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Little things:[/h3][list][*][p]Match fixer now works properly and has the correct icon[/p][/*][*][p]More sounds in Cage Fight[/p][/*][*][p]Cage Fight MMR adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Boot scene logo and volume aligned[/p][/*][*][p]Fulfilment camera fixes for bosses[/p][/*][*][p]"You're special" is now less annoying[/p][/*][*][p]New passive in Tower[/p][/*][*][p]Special abilities require more charge[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Also we're now Steam Deck verified! Now you can work on the move.[/p][p][/p][p]So get back to work![/p]

notes.title: Absolute Cinema - Bug fixes and balance
notes.notes: [p]We've fixed some of the most immediate and important bugs from launch! There are still some lingering around, but we'll get to those tomorrow. These changes haven't come to Mac yet, we'll get to that in the morning.[/p][p][/p][h3]Big things:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a softlock where the Expansion quest could not be completed[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Starbucks in Cage Fight (again)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some missing localisation strings (there are plenty left)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed locked progression in Cage Fight[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for an infinite hype bug in Cage Fight[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for some teleport bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Single stroke battle now deals damage[/p][/*][*][p]Added the credits to the build settings.
